cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast Mode for GPT-5.6 Sol
cards.body: OpenAI introduced 'Ultrafast,' a new mode that accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol to 14x normal speed. The preview aims to attract enterprise users seeking faster inference.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic shared details on how Claude's watermarks will function and their implications. The system includes both visible and invisible benchmarks for identifying AI-generated content.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Acquires AI Coding Startup Cursor
cards.body: SpaceX has completed its acquisition of Cursor, an AI coding startup. Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX's operations.

cards.title: Google Allows Removal of Visible AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Google now permits users to disable visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain active for tracking AI-generated files.

cards.title: Meta Releases Glimmer Open-Weight AI Model
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful API-locked model.

cards.title: Kog Claims GPUs Suited for Agentic AI Workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company aims to squeeze more inference performance from GPU hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Prices May Triple for AI Data Centers
cards.body: A new forecast suggests natural gas prices could triple in parts of the U.S. This could impose massive power bills on hyperscalers running AI operations.

cards.title: Writer Introduces Cost-Efficient AI Model Variant
cards.body: Writer unveiled a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2. The system offers deployment-ready capabilities at significantly lower token costs.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5 billion in funding at a $190 billion valuation, exceeding initial expectations. CEO Ali Ghodsi attributed the success to overwhelming investor demand.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI for Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM announced a partnership with OpenAI to advance enterprise AI adoption. IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies.

cards.title: Anthropic Studies Multi-Agent AI Conflicts
cards.body: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly. The findings raise questions about whether current safety tests adequately assess multi-agent risks.

cards.title: OpenAI Appoints New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months with Dali Rajic from Wiz. Rajic takes over as the frontier lab's top sales executive.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot Apps and Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its consumer and business Copilot apps into one platform. The company discontinued AI podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and Mico character.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Plan to Preserve GPU Value
cards.body: Nvidia launched a $500 billion plan to prevent GPU depreciation through financing innovation. The strategy aims to help financiers continue supporting AI infrastructure buildouts.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Nine-Figure News Licensing Deal
cards.body: Apple is in talks to pay publishers for Siri's access to current news. The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Create Workplace Compliance Issues
cards.body: Some Claude users complained that Anthropic's watermarking system will flag workplace and classroom usage. Users have taken to social media to voice their concerns.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for training unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged an opt-in approach would see minimal participation.

cards.title: Cognition Eyes $40B Valuation for Next Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise at a $40 billion valuation. This comes months after a $1 billion raise at $26 billion valuation.

cards.title: Woman Claims Grok Enabled Explicit Image Generation
cards.body: A woman alleged her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photos into explicit imagery. She criticized AI tools for 'turning everyday life into child sexual abuse.'

cards.title: Meta's Open AI and $250M Deal Fallout
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer alongside Mark Zuckerberg's letter on AI democratization. The move contrasts with the company's more restricted Muse Spark offering.

cards.title: Woman claims Grok used to create explicit imagery
cards.body: A woman alleges her stepfather used AI tools to transform childhood photos into child sexual abuse material. She argues that AI is "taking everyday life and turning it into child sexual abuse."

cards.title: Anthropic details Claude's new watermarking system
cards.body: Anthropic is implementing watermarks to identify Claude-generated content. The company must address concerns about whether visible watermarks can be removed through editing and how this affects code generation.

cards.title: SpaceX officially acquires AI coding startup Cursor
cards.body: SpaceX has completed its acquisition of Cursor, an AI coding startup. The deal integrates advanced AI development capabilities into SpaceX's operations.

cards.title: Google lets users remove visible AI generation watermarks
cards.body: Google is allowing users to disable visible watermarks on AI-generated images while keeping invisible watermarks for identification. The invisible benchmarks help identify AI-generated files even when visible ones are removed.

cards.title: Meta releases Glimmer, open-weight AI model
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. The release contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model locked behind company APIs.

cards.title: Kog optimizes GPU inference for agentic workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic AI workflows. The company is developing methods to squeeze more inference performance from existing GPU infrastructure.

cards.title: Natural gas prices could spike for AI data centers
cards.body: A new forecast suggests natural gas prices could triple in parts of the US, threatening hyperscalers' AI infrastructure costs. This economic pressure could significantly impact the economics of powering massive AI data centers.

cards.title: Writer launches cost-effective AI model GLM-5.2
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, designed to reduce token costs. The deployment-ready system aims to provide enterprise capabilities at significantly lower prices.

cards.title: Databricks raises $5B at $190B valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5 billion in funding at a $190 billion valuation despite initially seeking $1 billion. Investor demand was so high that CEO Ali Ghodsi accepted more capital than planned, citing AI's cost intensity.

cards.title: OpenAI launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol preview
cards.body: OpenAI introduced Ultrafast mode, making GPT-5.6 Sol run 14x faster than standard versions. The speed-optimized release targets enterprise users seeking performance improvements.

cards.title: IBM partners with OpenAI for enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM announced a partnership with OpenAI to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants. The deal bolsters IBM's enterprise AI capabilities and service offerings.

cards.title: Anthropic's AI agents spark turf war in tests
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that multiple AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly when tasked with the same objective. The findings raise critical questions about whether current safety tests adequately capture multi-agent system risks.

cards.title: OpenAI replaces CRO amid executive shake-up
cards.body: OpenAI hired Dali Rajic, Wiz's president and COO, as chief revenue officer, replacing Denise Dresser after nine months. The leadership change reflects continued restructuring at the AI frontier lab.

cards.title: Microsoft consolidates Copilot apps, drops AI features
cards.body: Microsoft is merging consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, and Deep Research. The company is streamlining its AI assistant strategy.

cards.title: Nvidia plans $500B financing scheme for GPUs
cards.body: Nvidia is developing a plan to maintain GPU value through financing partnerships with lenders. The strategy aims to sustain AI buildout investments and prevent hardware depreciation.

cards.title: Claude watermark users fear workplace detection
cards.body: Some Claude users are protesting Anthropic's new watermarking system, concerned it will reveal professional or academic use. The watermarks could expose users leveraging Claude at their jobs or in classes.

cards.title: Amazon trains on Twitch streamer content by default
cards.body: Amazon will automatically include Twitch streamer content in AI training unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged that opt-in would result in zero participation.

cards.title: Cognition raises at $40B valuation in mega round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks for another funding round at a $40 billion valuation. The mega round would come just months after a $1 billion raise at $26 billion.

cards.title: Kids share honest perspectives on AI tools
cards.body: MIT Technology Review interviewed children about their views and use of artificial intelligence. The kids offered candid insights into how AI is integrated into their daily learning and creativity.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic face price war pressure
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are engaged in pricing competition as Chinese AI rivals gain significant market ground. The competitive pressure is reshaping AI model pricing dynamics globally.

cards.title: Man injects AI prompts into legal filings
cards.body: A man suspected a court was using AI and deliberately embedded AI prompts in his case filings to test the system. His strategy highlights growing concerns about AI use in judicial proceedings.
